source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Ισχυρίων ο Επίσκοπος»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3078/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **This is not the corpus's `ischyrion`**, who carries a venerated Greek row on 1 June: that man is an Egyptian officer martyred in 250 under Decius with five of his own soldiers, while this one is a bishop who reposed in peace. Two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so two men, and the 1 June row is left exactly where it is. **No `office` is recorded**, because the page's own claim is hedged — «ίσως ήταν επίσκοπος Ταρσού», perhaps he was bishop of Tarsus — and the same day's listing keeps `helenus-of-tarsus`, whom it calls bishop of Tarsus without a hedge; the hedge stands in the life in the page's own words. No year, no hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
